# SCI-BEAM Rendered Outputs

The scientific-owner `r0.2` draft uses the canonical filenames:

- `SCI-BEAM-SCIENTIFIC-RATIONALE-v0.1.pdf`
- `SCI-BEAM-ENGINEERING-CONFORMANCE-v0.1.pdf`

The scientific-rationale file is the science-team explanation. The engineering-
conformance file is the Formal Scientific/Engineering Contract and carries the
complete normative core. Both remain review drafts: rendering does not accept
or freeze the authority or establish implementation or validation status.
